import yaml
from pathlib import Path

def deep_merge(a, b):
    if isinstance(a, dict) and isinstance(b, dict):
        out = dict(a)
        for k, v in b.items():
            out[k] = deep_merge(a.get(k), v) if k in a else v
        return out
    return b

base = yaml.safe_load(Path('{{base_yaml}}').read_text())
over = yaml.safe_load(Path('{{override_yaml}}').read_text())
merged = deep_merge(base, over)
Path('{{out_yaml}}').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(merged, sort_keys=False))
print('merged -> {{out_yaml}}')
